# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 30 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Residential Market

- **Private home prices up 0.5% in Q2 2026, led by landed homes** - URA's latest real estate statistics show the overall private residential property price index rose 0.5% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, easing from the 0.9% gain recorded in Q1, with landed homes driving the increase. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-q2-2026-report-breakdown/)

- **Dunearn House sells 56% at launch weekend, with three-bedroom units fully taken up** - The development moved 211 of 380 units over its 25–26 July launch weekend; Three-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom + Flexi unit types sold out completely, though overall take-up trailed the 2026 new launch average of 75.8%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-sold-55-at-launch-but-one-unit-type-sold-out-completely/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026 as buyers returned to the secondary market** - Transaction volumes picked up in June while prices held largely flat, pointing to a period of stabilisation in the private resale condo market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)

## HDB Resale & Housing Policy

- **HDB resale prices dipped 0.3% in Q2 2026, marking a second consecutive quarterly decline** - The HDB Resale Price Index slipped 0.3% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, even as transaction activity edged higher, according to the latest figures. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

- **15-month wait-out period for private property owners buying HDB resale flats removed** - The Government has removed the 15-month wait-out period with immediate effect, allowing eligible private residential property owners to purchase resale HDB flats directly, citing signs that the HDB resale market has stabilised. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

## En Bloc & Development Rules

- **Revised ABSD rules give developers up to seven years to complete and sell large en bloc redevelopment projects** - From 29 July, updated rules are in effect covering sales deadlines and unit ratio requirements for large en bloc sites, with the changes described as making redevelopment of mega sites easier for developers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/developers-face-easier-time-selling-large-enbloc-projects-but-not-sure-win-for-en-bloc-hopefuls/)
